hero.headline: Bringing tiny characters to life, one stitch at a time
hero.intro: Handmade amigurumi friends, dolls, accessories, and PDF patterns made for thoughtful gifts and joyful crochet projects.
hero.imageAlt: Crochet bear, yarn and tools in the Ambertinybear studio

paths.eyebrow: Choose what you are looking for
paths.title: A finished friend to keep, or a pattern for your next project?
paths.handmadeTitle: A finished friend to keep or gift
paths.handmadeBody: Limited handmade pieces crocheted with care, packed by the studio, and shipped according to your market.
paths.handmadeImageAlt: Collection of handmade crochet animals and dolls
paths.patternTitle: A pattern for your next project
paths.patternBody: Clear crochet instructions with private download access after the full order payment is confirmed.
paths.patternImageAlt: Crochet pattern pages, yarn and a work in progress on a studio table

featured.handmadeTitle: New handmade friends from the studio
featured.handmadeBody: Small-batch pieces shown according to your selected market, stock, and shipping eligibility.
featured.patternBody: PDF patterns stay protected until payment is confirmed, then open through private download access.

benefits.originalBody: Characters with personality, designed for collectors, gifts, and makers who love small details.
benefits.supportBody: Helpful pattern notes, photos, and guidance so you can make with confidence.
benefits.marketBody: Vietnam and international customers see eligible products, prices, payments, and shipping for their market.
benefits.secureBody: Pattern files are delivered through private, expiring links after payment confirmation.

trust.title: Made to feel personal, built to checkout safely.
trust.body: The storefront keeps the warmth of a small studio while protecting market pricing, payment confirmation, and digital delivery.
trust.market: VietQR for Vietnam and PayPal for international orders

story.title: From a small studio in Vietnam
story.body: Ambertinybear began with a hook, soft yarn, and the joy of watching a character appear stitch by stitch. Today, the studio creates finished crochet friends and patterns for makers around the world.
story.imageAlt: Hands crocheting a small bear at a bright studio table

awaiting_payment.heading: Awaiting payment
awaiting_payment.body: Review the exact total and complete payment before the reservation deadline.

verifying_payment.heading: Verifying payment
verifying_payment.body: PayPal returned you to the store. We are verifying the payment before updating your order.
verifying_payment.vietqrBody: The bank transfer is under seller review. PDF access and shipping remain locked until the full order is confirmed paid.

paid.physicalNext: We will update this page when your handmade items are packed and shipped.
paid.mixedNext: Your pattern downloads are ready, and we will update shipping for your handmade items below.

failed.heading: Payment failed
failed.body: This order cannot be retried. Start a new checkout to recalculate current stock and prices.

cancelled.heading: Payment cancelled
cancelled.body: Payment was cancelled and reserved items are no longer held for this order.

rejected.heading: Bank transfer rejected
rejected.body: The payment evidence was not accepted because the amount or reference did not match. The paid gate stays closed and this order cannot be retried.

expired.heading: Payment window expired
expired.body: The reservation deadline passed and items are no longer held for this order.
expired.vietqrBody: The VietQR transfer window expired. This order cannot be paid or fulfilled; start a new checkout for current stock and prices.

refunded.heading: Refunded

review_required.heading: Payment needs review

review_required.vietqrBody: The seller is checking the bank transfer details before changing the order status.

tracking.packing: The order is being packed. Tracking may appear after shipment.

paypal.unavailable: PayPal is not available for this order right now.
paypal.verifying: Payment received. We are confirming it with PayPal — this page updates on its own.
paypal.captureFailed: PayPal did not give us enough information to complete the payment. Check the order status before trying again.
paypal.captureUnreachable: We lost the connection to the shop while completing your payment. Do not pay again — check the order status first.
paypal.captureReview: Your payment arrived after the hold expired, so we are checking it by hand before releasing the order.
paypal.cancelled: Payment cancelled. Your order is still held — you can pay again below.
paypal.captureUncertain: We could not confirm whether your payment completed. Do not pay again — check the order status below, and contact us with your order number if it still says awaiting payment.
paypal.captureReconciliation: PayPal returned payment details that did not match this order. Do not pay again. Contact us with your order number so we can check the payment safely.
paypal.uncertainResult: We could not confirm the PayPal result. Do not pay again; check the order status.
paypal.pollingStopped: Automatic checks have stopped. Check again when you are ready.

vietqr.title: Transfer the exact amount and reference
vietqr.body: The order is confirmed only after the seller checks the bank account. Do not change the amount or transfer reference.
vietqr.unavailable: VietQR instructions are not available for this order right now.
vietqr.declareWarning: Only confirm this after the transfer has actually completed.
vietqr.declaredStatus: Recorded — we are checking the bank account.
vietqr.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically — select the text and copy it manually.
vietqr.qrUnavailable: The QR code could not load. Transfer manually with these details:

vietqr.declareForbidden: Your access to this order expired. Reopen it from the link in your order email, then confirm again.
vietqr.declareFailed: We could not record your confirmation. Please try again in a moment.
vietqr.stepOne: 1. Scan or download the QR code
